title: JUST TIRES PULLS INTO JOLIET, A CITY BUILT FOR THE DRIVE

body_markdown:
*As Route 66 turns 100, a new Just Tires store brings expert tire and auto care to a city that has always known a thing or two about the road.*


JOLIET, Ill., September 23, 2026 – In a city where cruise nights meet race weekends, Joliet drivers take pride in caring for the cars that keep them moving. Opened on Wednesday, Sept. 23, 2026, the new Just Tires location at 112 N Larkin Ave. brings expert tire and automotive care to the community.


From everyday commutes to trips to the track, Joliet drivers put plenty of miles on their cars. Backed by Goodyear’s more than 125 years of expertise, the store’s team of technicians is ready to help customers choose the right tires and care for their vehicles.


The new Joliet location offers a broad selection of Goodyear and Cooper tires, giving drivers trusted tire options for their vehicle, budget and driving needs. That includes Goodyear products such as the Goodyear Eagle F1 All Season for year-round performance; Goodyear Wrangler Steadfast HT for highway all-season performance and ride comfort; Goodyear Assurance WeatherReady 2 for all-weather driving; and Goodyear ElectricDrive 2 for EV-focused performance, along with tire options for high-performance, all-weather and all-terrain driving.


Services offered at the new Joliet location include:


- Tires and related services (installation, TPMS sensors, air refills)


- Oil changes
- Wheel alignments
- Brake service
- Battery replacement
- Free maintenance inspection


“Joliet has a strong connection to driving, from its place along historic Route 66, now celebrating its 100th anniversary, to the racing traditions that continue to bring people together,” said Matt Van Stedum, Just Tires store manager. “We are proud to be part of this community and give local drivers a new place to turn for knowledgeable, dependable tire and car care.”


As cooler weather approaches, the new Just Tires store can help Joliet drivers prepare their cars for the season ahead. With any service, customers receive a complimentary Courtesy Tire & Maintenance Inspection, during which a technician will check tire pressure and tread depth, along with the vehicle’s battery, brakes and accessible fluids. The store also offers free air to help drivers keep their tires properly inflated as temperatures drop, supporting tire performance and fuel efficiency.


To celebrate the opening, from Sept. 15 through Oct. 15, fans can enter the sweepstakes* by purchasing a set of four Goodyear tires on[Goodyear.com](https://www.goodyear.com/en-us/shops) or through[Goodyear’s Auto Service](https://www.goodyear.com/en-us/shops) and[Just Tires stores](https://www.justtires.com/en_US/tire-stores) and submitting the entry form[here](https://www.goodyear.com/en-us/blimp/golden-ticket-sweepstakes) . The randomly selected winner will receive a blimp flight certificate for two passengers that can be redeemed at any of Goodyear’s three U.S. airship bases in Akron, Ohio, Carson, California or Pompano Beach, Florida.


The Joliet Just Tires store is open Monday through Saturday from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. To schedule an appointment, visit[justtires.com](https://www.justtires.com/en_US/location/Joliet-IL-60435-US-000906016) or call 815-201-3180.


**ABOUT JUST TIRES**


Just Tires has been serving Illinois drivers since opening its first store in Chicago in 1991, pairing a broad selection of tire brands at competitive prices with specialists who help customers confidently choose the right tires. And despite the name, Just Tires does more than tires, offering automotive services such as brake repair, wheel alignments, oil changes and preventive maintenance.


Available services vary by location. Visit[justtires.com](https://www.justtires.com/) to schedule an appointment.


**About The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company**


Goodyear is one of the world's largest tire companies. It employs about 63,000 people and manufactures its products in 48 facilities in 19 countries around the world. Its two Innovation Centers in Akron, Ohio, and Colmar-Berg, Luxembourg, strive to develop state-of-the-art products and services that set the technology and performance standard for the industry. For more information about Goodyear and its products, go to[www.goodyear.com/corporate](http://www.goodyear.com/corporate)
